messages.subject: Resolved Astra P1 cache defect and temporal validity blockers
messages.body: Resolved Astra P1 cache defects by implementing an immutable sample-identity cache keyed on full image/support bytes and loader metadata with cadence interval indexing and fail-closed physical metadata, and fixed temporal registration with support-aware apodization, conservative bilinear validity support (>0.999), explicit out-of-bounds motion rejection, and mapped-coordinate forward-backward occlusion checks. All 30 owned unit tests and 149 volume test suite tests pass cleanly, confirming cross-patient isolation, interior voxel change detection, exact checkpoint state recovery, and robust adversarial rejection of invalid textures, fractional boundary contamination, and out-of-bounds displacements. Software implementation and CPU verification are complete; integration owners can downstream these stable APIs for real-data runs on server GPU hardware when authorized.

messages.subject: Model ready recheck: DINO encoder/decoder widths conflated
messages.body: models.py _configured_widths describes decoder stage widths; _load_native_student checks DINO widths==(96,192,384,768), which are encoder channels, while canonical NativeStudent default decoder widths are(96,128,192,256). Thus correctly declared historical decoder widths reject and accepted encoder-channel tuple is silently ignored by NativeStudent(OfficialStages(original)) default. Fix both normal/architecture_only validation against actual decoder widths and test declared-vs-actual lateral out_channels using fake DINO. Also hybrid z_kernels retains only tuple[0], accepting arbitrary ignored XY components; reject non-neutral XY or define schema onlydepth. Provenance initialization remains native_tiny_synthetic for real DINO; label real pretrained accurately. MAC cost still sums stage-local locations and omits grouped-conv divisor; it cannot be called total native-voxel FLOPs.
